{{Hr|SS}}

<b>Steel Soul Mode</b> is a game mode in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that is unlocked after finishing the game for the first time, or by inputting: <code>up</code>, <code>down</code>, <code>up</code>, <code>down</code>, <code>left</code>, <code>right</code>, <code>left</code>, <code>right</code> on the "Extras" page.

<div class="grid grid--align-center" style="max-width: 1920px;">
<div class="grid__col--span-12" style="justify-self: center;">
{{typography|tag=p|style=margin: .5rem 0 0; text-align: center;|type=h1|text=Changes}}
* [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] does not respawn upon death. Once Hornet dies, the game ends, and the [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]] is reset. 
** Hornet may be defeated by [[First Sinner]], [[Shakra]], [[Garmond and Zaza]],<ref group="Note">Being hit into the spikes counts as an actual death.</ref> and within [[Elegy of the Deep]] memories without deleting the save profile. 
** Trying to enter a failed Steel Soul run results in being prompted to clear the save slot. The save slot also says the word "DEFEATED" instead of the location the game was last saved in.
*** Exiting and reloading the saved slot when close to death can prevent the slot "DEFEATED".
* [[Styx]] is dead in his nest, with a new passage leading to [[Skynx]]. [[Silkeater|Silkeaters]] can be sold to Skynx for {{R|46–154}}.<ref group="Note">Skynx gives either {{R|50}}, {{R|100}}, or {{R|150}}, with a variation of up to {{R|4}}.</ref>
** The two [[Void Mass]]es that appear in his nest during [[Act 3]] no longer appear as well.
** The <i>[[Queen's Egg (Wish)|Queen's Egg]]</i> [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] is no longer available as a result, and the [[Queen's Egg]] [[Materium]] entry is unobtainable. The <i>[[Liquid Lacquer (Wish)|Liquid Lacquer]]</i> Delivery Wish now has different prerequisites to accommodate for this.
* In [[Blasted Steps]], a room with a [[Silkeater]] is replaced with [[Steel Seer Zi]] and her wish, ''[[A Vassal Lost]]''.
** The wish features a new NPC named [[Sula]], an exclusive boss fight against [[Summoned Saviour]] at the end of a new passageway in [[Bone Bottom]], and completing it rewards Hornet with the [[Growstone]].
* [[Dead Bug's Purse]] is replaced with [[Shell Satchel]].
* The White [[Bellhome]] Bell Lacquer is replaced by Chrome.
